purpose: Verify only backup-authorized administrators may trigger a manual backup.
preconditions: An authenticated principal without and with badms.backup.trigger permission.
action_or_input: Invoke manual backup for each principal.
expected_result: Unauthorized trigger is denied; authorized trigger proceeds.

purpose: Verify manual backup records point-in-time artifacts and an outcome.
preconditions: An authorized principal requests manual backup.
action_or_input: Trigger backup and inspect persisted operation.
expected_result: Current timestamp, dump reference, and Success or Failure status are recorded.

purpose: Verify failed backup records Failure and alerts SysAdmin.
expected_result: Failure status and SysAdmin alert are recorded.
test_type: NOT_AUTOMATED: no backup failure execution/alert adapter exists

purpose: Verify a user can track a restoration request's status.
preconditions: A restoration request for archived data exists.
action_or_input: Submit request and retrieve its status.
expected_result: Current request status is available to the user.

purpose: Verify storage thresholds are monitored for all users.
preconditions: Storage usage is available for multiple users.
expected_result: Every user's usage is assessed against the applicable threshold.
test_type: NOT_AUTOMATED: no batch threshold-monitoring operation exists
